slides.title: Tigray's ambulances have run out of fuel
ambulances unable to operate by September
slides.body: Tigray health officials told Refugees International. 740 outreach vehicles were also grounded.

slides.title: liters of fuel the health sector needs each month
slides.body: Officials said none of it had arrived by the time of the survey.

slides.title: of essential medicines still available, officials said
slides.body: They also reported no cholera kits in the region.

slides.title: Health workers unpaid
slides.body: Officials said nearly all health workers went unpaid in August after federal salary transfers stopped.

slides.title: Federal side disputes cutoff
slides.body: In February, Ethiopia's Petroleum and Energy Authority called fuel cutoff claims false (The Reporter).
